title: to savoring
slide_intent: Complete the shift from an ingredient to an eating experience. A change of type and image can make the difference between buying and enjoying perceptible.
strategic_value: The same campaign can move from practical shopping language to an expressive food moment without losing its narrative connection.
demonstration: A close-up of a bowl of macaroni and stretching cheese fills the page. The light high-contrast phrase to savoring rests over the bowl.
practical_value: Use the display treatment and an appetizing detail when the message shifts from acquiring an item to enjoying a meal.

content_islands.name: Food close-up
content_islands.spec: Fill the canvas with the bowl and the food rising above it. Retain a darker area across the lower bowl for the overlay.

content_islands.name: Savoring phrase
content_islands.spec: Set two lines of large light display type at lower left to answer the preceding shopping phrase.
